method: CUA native app controls, under the existing explicit approval to temporarily enable VoiceOver and restore settings. No shell-driven system changes, browser injection, OS clipboard access or new input source installation.

observations: System Settings AX_VOICEOVER_ENABLED changed from off to on after clicking its switch. The app inventory nevertheless reported com.apple.VoiceOver isRunning=false.
Opened Apple's VoiceOver Tutorial via the observed settings button. The tutorial displayed page 1 of 11, The VoiceOver Modifier, and asked for Control-Option-Space.
ctrl+alt+space did not visibly advance the tutorial. Raising its window and repeating the shortcut still left page 1 displayed.
Restored the System Settings VoiceOver switch to off, verified by its accessibility state.

Reacquiring the tutorial revealed a separate Turn on VoiceOver / Continue without VoiceOver prompt. Clicking Turn on VoiceOver returned to page 1, but Control_L+Alt_L+space did not advance it, and the inventory still reported VoiceOver not running.
Quit the temporary tutorial through its application menu. Subsequent inventory reported Accessibility Tutorial and VoiceOver both not running; the pre-existing VoiceOver Utility remained running.

After the prompt/menu cleanup, the settings AX diff reported no VoiceOver switch change from the previously observed off state. A subsequent attempt to obtain a new complete settings window returned an empty/menu-only surface and then noWindowsAvailable. No further native settings actions were taken.
nativeControl.interpretation: The requested screen-reader command was not observably delivered even in Apple's tutorial, without Breditor involved. A settings switch alone is insufficient evidence. Activation, inventory and automation behavior remain uncertain; this does not prove an OS fault or an editor defect.
nativeControl.restorationLimit: Last readable switch state was off, and final inventory reported VoiceOver not running. No fresh complete settings-window observation was available at the end. No VoiceOver Utility preferences or keyboard/input-source settings were changed during this follow-up.
